title: Sol Divide
overview:
The demon king Iftar is conquering kingdom after kingdom in a plot to revive the dragon-shaped evil god Heladios. Three heroes rise against him: Vogue, a former holy knight turned dark knight to win back his homeland; Kashuon, a winged warrior out to avenge his father; and Tiora, a sorceress and temple guardian chasing the stolen spirit stones.

This arcade shooting game mixes shots with close-range sword slashes and magic. Clear each screen of its enemies to move on, power up your shot, collect potions and magic books, and unleash spells such as Fire, Thunder and Freeze. Each hero plays differently, from Vogue's powerful sword to Kashuon's speed and Tiora's strong shots and magic.

- 2-player simultaneous play, with a second player able to join mid-game
- Original Mode with enemies, bosses and dungeons not found in the arcade version
- Monkey Mode for beginners
